result.document_summary: A Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board guide table showing which unit and tenancy types are covered by the city's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance (registration, rent control, just cause, security deposit interest).
result.notes: The document is a coverage guide table, not the ordinance text, and says it is only a guide. No ordinance section numbers, cap amounts, or effective dates are given, so effective_date is blank and confidence is moderate. Two records were extracted (rent control and just cause) with shared coverage. Security deposit interest coverage is mentioned but no deposit rule (amount, rate, deadline) is stated, so no security_deposits record was created. The table lists both a 'built before 1980' multifamily rule and a 'Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980' rule, which leaves a gap for units built in 1980 itself; the document does not resolve this, so the coverage cutoff of 1980-01-01 is a best reading of 'before 1980'.

rules.title: Berkeley rent control coverage under the Rent Stabilization Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to most multifamily units built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses; newer construction, later single-family tenancies and most condominiums are only partially covered and are not subject to rent control.
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes
rules.coverage_text: Most multifamily units built before 1980 are subject to rent control; single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996 and rooming houses with five or more individually rented rooms are also fully covered.

rules.exemptions_text: Exempt: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied on 12/31/1979 and currently), units sharing a kitchen/bath with an owner who lived there at tenancy start, ADU properties with owner-occupancy for tenancies after Nov 7, 2018, university units, and nonprofit cooperatives. Newer construction (Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980), single-family homes with tenancies beginning on or after 1/1/1996, most condominiums and certain HUD-subsidized units are only partially covered (registration, just cause and deposit interest apply but not rent control).

rules.title: Berkeley just cause for eviction coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction protections apply to fully covered units and also to partially covered units (newer construction, post-1996 single-family tenancies, most condominiums, and certain subsidized units), but not to exempt unit types.
rules.quoted_span: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980** Partially Covered Yes No Yes Yes
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental units in Berkeley are covered by just cause for eviction (including newer construction, post-1996 single-family tenancies and most condominiums) except the listed exempt unit types.
